chunks: (Moses) said: "O Lord, forgive me and my brother, and admit us to Your grace, for You are the most compassionate of all."
ai.seo_question: What was the supplication of Prophet Moses (AS) to seek forgiveness and mercy?
ai.summary: This verse, revealed in Surah Al-A'raf, captures Prophet Moses (AS) invoking forgiveness for himself and his brother Aaron (AS) after the incident of the Golden Calf, demonstrating the prophetic virtue of interceding for others. It underscores the Shia emphasis on *rahmah* (mercy) as the ultimate divine attribute, linking personal repentance with communal salvation. The supplication serves as a model for believers to seek entry into divine grace through humility and recognition of God's boundless compassion.
